standard-dialogue-in-east-ardougne-befor.npc: Do you have a problem traveller?

standard-dialogue-in-east-ardougne-befor.player: No, I just wondered why you're wearing that outfit... Is it fancy dress?

standard-dialogue-at-the-ardougne-wall-b.npc: I'm guarding the border to West Ardougne. No one except we mourners can pass through.
The plague of course. We can't risk cross contamination.

options.text: What brought the plague to Ardougne?

steps.player: What brought the plague to Ardougne?

steps.npc: It's all down to King Tyras of West Ardougne. It started came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
Some of his men must have unknowingly caught it out there and brought it back with them

steps.player: Does he know how bad the situation is now?

steps.npc: If he did he wouldn't care. I believe he wants his people to suffer, he's an evil man.

options.text: What are the symptoms of the plague?

steps.player: What are the symptoms of the plague?

steps.npc: The first signs are typical flu symptoms. These tend to be followed by severe nightmares, horrifying hallucinations which drive many to madness.
It gets worse. Next the victim's blood changes into a thick black tar-like liquid, at this point they're past help.
Their skin is cold to the touch, the victim is now brain dead. Their body however lives on driven by the virus, roaming like a zombie, spreading itself further wherever possible.

standard-dialogue-at-the-ardougne-wall-a.npc: This is no place for sight-seeing. Don't you know there's been a plague outbreak?
Then I suggest you leave as soon as you can.

options.text: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
What are the symptoms of the plague?

standard-dialogue-in-west-ardougne-befor.npc: Hmmm, how did you get over here? You're not one of this rabble. Ah well, you'll have to stay. Can't risk you going back now.

steps.npc: We're working for King Lathas of East Ardougne. He has tasked us with containing the accursed plague sweeping West Ardougne.
We also do our best to ease these people's suffering. We're nicknamed mourners because we spend a lot of time at plague victim funerals, no one else is allowed to risk attending.
It's a demanding job, and we get little thanks from the people here.

options.text: I haven't got the plague though...

steps.player: I haven't got the plague though...

steps.npc: Can't risk you being a carrier. That protective clothing you have isn't regulation issue. It won't meet safety standards.

options.text: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.

steps.player: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.

steps.npc: Ah yes, I've heard of her. A healer I believe. She must be mad coming over here voluntarily.
I hear rumours she has probably caught the plague now. Very tragic, a stupid waste of life.
